title: Is this value in the list?
idea: Opener: the idea of searching — ask whether a value is present, answer yes or no. Thinking first.

exercises.prompt: You have [4, 8, 2, 9] and want to know: is 8 in this list?
options: Yes — 8 is one of the items
exercises.explanation: 8 appears in the list, so the answer is yes. Searching asks a simple yes/no: is the value present?

options: checking whether a particular value is present (yes or no)
exercises.explanation: A search answers 'is it in there?'. The output is a yes/no, not a new list.

exercises.prompt: A search question has a yes-or-no answer: the value is either present or it is not.
exercises.explanation: That is the heart of searching — present or absent. Later you can also ask WHERE it is.
None of the items equals 7, so the answer is no. The value is absent.

exercises.prompt: Which of these are 'is it in there?' (search) questions? (pick all)
options: Does anyone have a score of 100?
Is the number 13 in the list?
exercises.explanation: Three ask whether a value is present. 'What is the total' is a sum, not a search.

exercises.prompt: How is searching DIFFERENT from filtering?
options: search answers yes/no about one value; filter builds a list of all matches
exercises.explanation: Filter collects every match into a list; search just checks whether one value is present at all.

exercises.prompt: To search, you still look through the items one by one, just like other list tools.
exercises.explanation: You visit the items with a loop and compare each to the value you are looking for.
2 is present (several times, in fact), so the answer is simply yes. Duplicates do not change a yes/no.

exercises.prompt: Put the plain-English steps of a search in order.
blocks: Go through each item, comparing it to the value you want
If an item matches, remember that you found it
exercises.explanation: Start by assuming it is absent, check every item, and flip to 'found' the moment one matches.

options: searching a list: checking whether (and where) a value is present
exercises.explanation: You will search a list to answer 'is it in there?' and 'where is it?'.
